captions.detailed: This 3D model is a flat, oval-shaped keychain base with a raised outer lip forming a shallow tray. A small, semi-circular ring attachment protrudes from one of the narrow ends of the oval, serving as a mounting point for a keyring. The main body of the keychain has a smooth, flat interior surface designed to accommodate customized text.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric oval keychain in OpenSCAD with an adjustable raised border (lip) and an integrated keyring loop on one end. The script should allow customization of the overall width, length, height, lip thickness, ring dimensions, and include a module to render custom text on the flat surface.
captions.factory: The keychain is constructed using a difference() operation. The base shape is created by combining a scaled cylinder and a cube using the minkowski() helper to form the rounded, raised-rim oval, which is unioned with a small toroid loop made from rotate_extrude() of a square. A slightly smaller scaled cylinder is subtracted from the top of this assembly to hollow out the inner tray, leaving the raised lip. Finally, text is rendered in the center of the tray using the write() library.
